blocks.text: The VSEPR model predicts and explains the shapes of molecules but gives no reason for the formation of bonds. Valence bond theory is concerned with both the formation of bonds and the shapes of molecules. This way of describing a covalent bond treats a molecule as a combination of atoms.

items: A covalent bond is formed when half-filled orbitals in the valence shells of two atoms of similar energy overlap.
A greater overlap of the orbitals results in a stronger bond.
Covalent bonds are directional: the direction of the bond is determined by the shape and mode of the overlapping orbitals.
